ns2:section.sectionText: Registration restricted to Food Science, Food Industry and Business, and Dietetics majors only until after junior registration, then open to all FSHN majors and graduate students. Outside majors should register in lecture section 53491. Students registered in lecture section 53491 will be charged a $50 lab fee. Seats will be available in 53491 after junior registration.
ns2:section.sectionDeptRestriction: Restricted to students in the Food Science & Human Nutrition department.
